== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tauntaun Bones (Japanese)|Tauntaun Bones]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/170462293/YcERMRQyMU6sPhpSe-33og.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 170462293.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>521488d5f8898f474f0fd5d7454ec9bd449599ede94756c88f214faae7c80e62</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
